name: sinceai-2026
phaseName: Phase 8: the slides are final, the repository is public under MIT, two cuts of the video exist on the owner's voice; the owner's upload, submission and vote remain
state: Session 2 (6.11.2026, Code on the Mac): Elisa's challenge is selected and the decisions P1 to P6 are made. Phase 0 (skeleton, health check), phase 1 (Elisa's files unchanged, synthetic sources, events, seed graph, truth set, held-out binding set) phase 2 (store, export, /graph), phase 3 (extraction, binding, merging, recorded answers, scoring) phase 4 (claims_for, access_for, the prohibition, counters from telemetry), phase 5 (firmware recheck, outcomes from telemetry, the log line from device events) and phase 6 (the page, ten scenes) are in main. Session 3 (7.11.2026, Code on the Mac): a technical check, then the owner's checkpoint: the page looked confusing at first glance, so it was rebuilt for clarity (a story per scene, plain words, readable evidence, named claims) and waits for a second look. The product is named Silent context and the repository is renamed. The Cypher export loads into Neo4j. A clean install from git archive passed with no key. Phase 7 is done: docs/acceptance.md holds the build plan's cases A0 to A11 and a test keeps every computed row passing. The README has its diagram and its tested section, and docs/what-is-simulated.md exists. Phase 8: the owner approved the larger-text picture as a pre-version on 7.11. and asked for two things, both built: the captions in a black band under the picture (never over it) and a 20 second pitch in front (two cards in the page's look, narration blocks 01 and 02). The MCP wrapper (app/mcp_server.py, the mcp package) exposes claims_for, access_for and source as tools, tested over an in-memory transport and as a real stdio process. The owner voiced the narration in ElevenLabs, and the final video is built: 127.2 s, 1920 by 1080, the captions in the band, in the pipeline's media folder and in the owner's Desktop folder. The repository went public under the MIT licence on 7.11. after gitleaks found nothing in the full history. The slides exist: docs/slides/silent-context.pptx and the PDF beside it, ten slides from docs/slides.md in the page's look, with speaker notes, every sentence read against the README, acceptance.md and what-is-simulated.md, rendered and looked at; written by the scripts in docs/slides/build/. Session 4 (7.11.2026, Code on the Mac): the builders' guide was read: the video is accepted only as a public or unlisted YouTube link, no file; the form's fields are known and every field's text is in the Desktop folder's submission-notes.md (a 128-character tagline, the About text, Built with, the GenAI answer); the PDF goes in as the pitch deck. The work was read as a judge and as an ordinary viewer (README, narration, the ten scenes, the slide text): nothing changed in the product, the findings are in the CHANGELOG. Sunday: the deadline 10:00, the participant vote 10:00 to 12:00, finalists at 12:00, presence needed only from finalists. Later in session 4: the README's Demo section opens with a picture of the page at scene 4; the owner has a Finnish plain-language paper on the Desktop ("Silent context suomeksi", not in the repository); a second cut of the video on a plain-language narration v3 is proposed as decision 18 (A new cut, B zooms and story cards on the existing take, C keep), open. The owner chose A for decision 18 and the second cut was built the same evening: narration v3 in plain words, four story cards, the page zoomed toward the panel each sentence is about, the owner's new ElevenLabs track aligned to it; the final is 117.6 s, 12.7 MB, in the Desktop folder "Silent context submission" beside the first cut. The submission package is now the Desktop folder "Silent context submission V2": the second cut, the five-picture deck (docs/slides/silent-context-in-five.pdf, from docs/slides/five/) as the pitch deck, the full deck as a supporting document, the zip and the notes; the first package stays in "Silent context submission" as the fallback.

next_session.name: The submission
next_session.scope: Phase 8 of the Atlas artifact SINCEAI-2026-ELISA-RAKENNUSSUUNNITELMA is built and the submission's texts are written. What remains is the owner's: the YouTube upload (P-10), the submission by Sunday 8.11. 09:30 (P-3) and the vote 10:00 to 12:00 (P-11), all from the Desktop folder "Silent context submission V2" and its submission-notes.md. The source zip there is built from main's tip; rebuild it with git archive if main moves. The second cut (decision 18, A) is built and in the Desktop folder beside the first; the owner watches both and uploads one (P-10). A change to the second cut's words is a change to video/narration-v3.md and a new ElevenLabs track; a change to its picture is video/story.html or video/scenes_v3.py and a new take, then cut_from_take.py, assemble and final as video/README.md says. The zip is rebuilt after every commit to main. Rule authors do not read data/truth/decoys, expected_decoys.json or data/extractions/decoys. After the event: REPO-2 (the Atlas system, then docs/adr/) and P-8 (the main PC's remote).
next_session.gate: The owner's submission in sinceai.app by Sunday 8.11. 09:30, the video as an unlisted YouTube link.

workflow: Code, comments, commits and documentation in English; conversation with the owner in Finnish. During the event straight to main in small commits; never force-push or rewrite history. One phase at a time, a line to the Atlas thread at each phase's end, the owner's checkpoint after phases 1, 3, 4 and 6. End a session by updating BUILD_INFO.json, CHANGELOG.md, BACKLOG.md, DECISIONS.md and, when a lesson was paid for, LESSONS.md.
